## 摘要

荷兰邮轮上汉坦病毒感染病例已上升至5例，世界卫生组织正在密切监测。据多家媒体报道，一名乘客已因此死亡。目前当局正在追踪所有离开邮轮的乘客，以防止病毒进一步传播。汉坦病毒通常通过啮齿动物传播，人际传播较为罕见。

## Summary

Hantavirus cases from a Dutch cruise ship have risen to 5, with the WHO closely monitoring the situation. One passenger has died. Authorities are tracing all passengers who disembarked to prevent further spread. Hantavirus is typically transmitted through rodents, and human-to-human transmission is rare.
